tier_reason: The only harness behind the numbers (ketotek/crypto-bench) performs no output check, feeds never-initialized key and input buffers to Botan and libgcrypt and reads Crypto++'s output through strlen on an uninitialized buffer (undefined behaviour), keys the AF_ALG row with a reduced 8-byte CAST5 key, and its pre-1.6.0 libgcrypt baseline is stale by enough (1.9.0 CAST5 40-70% faster) to erase the 1.34x gap; no valid measurement remains, so directional only.

corrections.caveats: Harness UB and unchecked output; libgcrypt baseline pre-1.6.0; counter-evidence from scc-tw/cryptobench-cpp is also flawed (8.9.0 never selects hardware crypto on Apple chips other than plain M1, #1373). No release since 8.9.0 (2023-10-01); open #1364/#1369, #1247, #1249; CAST-128 obsolescent per Crypto++.

tier_reason: Tier stays C. Caveat correction: the conflicting RSA-2048 verify snippets come from bssl speed's two verify rows (the fresh-key row rebuilds the key and Montgomery context every call while openssl speed reuses one key) and from different run lengths (1 s vs 10 s per row); the centminmod page itself remains unreachable.

corrections.caveats: bssl speed fresh-key RSA verify row is not comparable to openssl speed; run lengths 1 s vs 10 s; OpenSSL ran -multi 2 so BoringSSL is about 1.14x faster per process at RSA sign (derived); ChaCha20-Poly1305 about 1.8x slower on Zen 5; bssl speed replaced by bssl_bench at HEAD; no ocsp.h; HAProxy dropped support.

corrections.claimed_speedup: jgoerzen run: gpg 2.2.27 16.97 s vs sq 36.60 s (2.16x, derived from page data), CFB+MDC both sides; the Sequoia issue #771 armored row (2.70x) is dominated by armoring speed.
corrections.caveats: No control run, single runs, no versions in #771; Sequoia fixed its armor CRC24 days later (#772); decryption reversed in the same thread; CFB encrypt serial in libgcrypt (AES256.CFB 783 MB/s on a 5800X per commit ab177eed51); gpg OCB uses the LibrePGP packet, not SEIPDv2; gpg 2.4.5 lists keys 4.9-8.1x faster than gpg-sq 0.9.0 (sequoia-chameleon-gnupg #83).
